identity.name: Pastasciutta Roma
identity.aesthetic: Italian Street Food x Digital Efficiency
identity.mission: Streamline the chaos of a Roman pasta kitchen with high-visibility, touch-first design.

buttons.default: h-12 px-6 rounded-md font-bold uppercase tracking-wide transition-transform active:scale-95
buttons.kitchen_touch: h-16 text-xl w-full flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg shadow-sm border-2 border-transparent active:border-black/10

cards.order_ticket: bg-white border-2 border-gray-200 rounded-lg p-4 shadow-sm flex flex-col gap-2 relative overflow-hidden
cards.dashboard_nav: aspect-square flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 text-2xl font-bold uppercase bg-white border-2 border-transparent hover:border-[#F5C518] shadow-md hover:shadow-lg transition-all

inputs.touch_friendly: h-14 text-lg px-4 rounded-md border-2 border-gray-300 focus:border-[#2563EB] focus:ring-0

kitchen_display.grid_cols: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-5 gap-4 p-4
kitchen_display.notes: Dense packing for maximum visibility of orders.

cashier.left_panel: col-span-12 md:col-span-4 bg-white p-6 rounded-xl shadow-sm border
cashier.right_panel: col-span-12 md:col-span-8 bg-white p-6 rounded-xl shadow-sm border overflow-y-auto

motion.page_transition: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. HEADER: Must be fixed height (h-16 or h-20), Background #F5C518. Logo/Text left, 'Esci' button right (black).
2. LOGIN: Full screen. Use the 'login_bg' image with an overlay. Centered white card for inputs.
3. CASSA (Cashier): Priority is speed. Input field should be auto-focused. List should show latest orders at top.
4. BOLLITORE (Kitchen): Orders are cards. Background color of the card header changes based on timer status (Green -> Red).
5. TIMERS: Use specific colors requested. Green (<2m), Pink/Red (>2m), White (Not started).
6. LANGUAGE: UI must be in Italian (e.g., 'Utente', 'Password', 'Accedi', 'Invia', 'Annulla').
7. FONTS: Import Barlow Condensed for all headings. It gives the 'Receipt/Ticket' look.
8. TESTIDS: Add data-testid to every button and input for testing.

do_not_use: Gradients on buttons (use flat bold colors)
must_use: shadcn/ui components customized to match the theme
